text: 为了进一步规范基金估值业务，中国证券投资基金业协会对已发布的《关于发布中基协（AMAC）基金行业股票估值指数的通知》《黄金交易型开放式证券投资基金及联接基金会计核算和估值业务指引》《证券投资基金港股通投资资金清算和会计核算估值业务指引（试行）》《基金中基金估值业务指引（试行）》《证券投资基金投资流通受限股票估值指引（试行）》《证券投资基金投资信用衍生品估值指引（试行）》《关于固定收益品种的估值处理标准》和《私募投资基金非上市股权投资估值指引（试行）》作出修订。其中部分自律规则涉及名称修改。
text_en: To further standardize fund valuation practices, the Asset Management Association of China (AMAC) has revised the previously issued "Notice on the Release of the AMAC Fund Industry Stock Valuation Index," "Guidelines for Accounting and Valuation of Gold Exchange-Traded Open-End Securities Investment Funds and Feeder Funds," "Guidelines for Clearing, Accounting and Valuation of Securities Investment Fund Investments via Stock Connect (Trial)," "Guidelines for Valuation of Funds of Funds (Trial)," "Guidelines for Valuation of Securities Investment Funds Investing in Restricted Shares (Trial)," "Guidelines for Valuation of Securities Investment Funds Investing in Credit Derivatives (Trial)," "Standards for Valuation of Fixed-Income Instruments," and "Guidelines for Valuation of Private Fund Non-Listed Equity Investments (Trial)." Some of these self-regulatory rules involve changes to their names.
